notes: How tools/build-item-tags.mjs combines the proposals. Tags with the same key are merged (their rules are combined: an item matching any of them gets the tag). When proposals give a tag different parents, the more specific one wins (the one under the other); 'parents' settles the rest. 'renameKeys' renames a key inside one proposal before merging, to split two different meanings or join two names for one thing.
